metadata.case_name: TSANG WAH LAM v. SUN MAY KING PUBLISHING CO. LTD. T/A SUN MAY KING PRINTING CO.

plaintiff.expected_occupation_after: security guard, carpark attendant or similar occupation

injuries.description: right forearm crush injury with open fracture of right radius and ulna;
source: right forearm crush injury with open fracture of right radius and ulna;

injuries.description: severe soft issue injury of forearm and hand;
source: severe soft issue injury of forearm and hand;
injuries.icd_description: Injury of multiple muscles or tendons at forearm level

injuries.description: dislocations of distal interphanlangeal joints of right thumb and ring finger.
injuries.body_part: right thumb and right ring finger (distal interphalangeal joints)
source: dislocations of distal interphanlangeal joints of right thumb and ring finger.

injuries.description: Serial radiological examinations of the right forearm revealed non-union of his old fractures.
source: Serial radiological examinations of the right forearm revealed non-union of his old fractures.

injuries.description: the right thumb was fused at the Plaintiff's interphalangeal and metacarphal-phalangeal joint.
source: the right thumb was fused at the Plaintiff's interphalangeal and metacarphal-phalangeal joint.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the wrist or hand

injuries.description: peri-trapezium axial disruption of the carpus of the right thumb.
source: There was peri-trapezium axial disruption of the carpus of the right thumb.
injuries.icd_description: Dislocation of other specified part of thumb

manifestations.description: pain, stiffness and weakness of the right wrist and hand
major loss of muscle bulk of the forearm
movement of the basal joint of the thumb were limited and so were the movements of the joints of other fingers
partial loss of sensation of the fingers
unable to use heavy tools such as drills or hammers or carry heavy weight with his right hand
cannot grip with his right hand
unable to use chopsticks or write properly
embarrassment and had developed a complex about the scars on his right arm

treatments_received: urgent debridement and fixation of the fractures (performed on day of admission)
correction of right thumb deformity and fusion of the interphalangeal and metacarphal-phalangeal joint of the right thumb (admitted 28 December 1999)
treatments_future: cosmetic surgery (fat injection and laser treatment) recommended by Dr Otto Au

losses.description: Major loss of hand and wrist function due to structural damage; inability to use right hand as before; inability to use heavy tools, grip, carry heavy weight.
Ugly scars on the right forearm and right hand; ugly defect on the left hip and ugly scars on the thighs; embarrassment and developed a complex about the scars on his right arm.

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Unable to use chopsticks or write properly; needs adjustment in writing.

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies

losses.description: Probably unable to return to work as a printing technician; restricted to non-manual jobs.
